A verified non-admin is restricted to retrieving a file by both file ID and user ID, which binds the source-file operation to the caller's file ownership. The caller-controlled collection_name is then assigned directly, with only a default used when it is absent. The crop expressly states that the intervening code contains no call authorizing collection_name. The resulting collection_name is passed to save_docs_to_vector_db, whose visible sink inserts items into VECTOR_DB_CLIENT using that collection name. No destination ownership or explicit write-grant check is visible before the write. Thus, under the supplied condition that the selected collection exists and the user lacks destination write permission, the user can cause the file content to be written there, contrary to the stated policy.

results.explanation: The fixed source supports the declared authorization failure. POST /process/file authenticates the caller as a verified user. For a non-admin, it checks only that the source file belongs to the caller. The destination collection is independently caller-selected through form_data.collection_name; when supplied, that value is retained and the call sets add=True. The supplied crop expressly states that the intervening path contains no call authorizing collection_name. The selected name is passed with the processed docs to save_docs_to_vector_db, whose visible sink inserts the resulting items into VECTOR_DB_CLIENT under that collection name. Thus source-file ownership is enforced, but the required destination ownership or explicit write-grant condition is not, allowing the declared non-admin file owner to direct the write to the specified existing collection despite lacking destination write permission.

results.explanation: The fixed source supports the declared failure. A verified non-admin is restricted to retrieving a file by both file ID and user ID, which binds the source-file operation to the caller's file ownership. The caller-controlled collection_name is then assigned directly, with only a default used when it is absent. The crop expressly states that the intervening code contains no call authorizing collection_name. The resulting collection_name is passed to save_docs_to_vector_db, whose visible sink inserts items into VECTOR_DB_CLIENT using that collection name. No destination ownership or explicit write-grant check is visible before the write. Thus, under the supplied condition that the selected collection exists and the user lacks destination write permission, the user can cause the file content to be written there, contrary to the stated policy.
